comparison.objective: Raise a hinged mast using two guy lines and peg both rings so the mast remains plumb.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated tensioning and ring-on-peg placement for a large articulated structure, not localized impact fracture.
comparison.success_condition: Both rings are on their respective pegs and the released mast stands plumb; numeric plumb tolerance is absent.
comparison.reason: Cable-supported erection and stabilization have a different physical mechanism and final state.
